identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase 1b Study of Atezolizumab in Combination With Vemurafenib or Vemurafenib Plus Cobimetinib in Participants With BRAFV600-Mutation Positive Metastatic Melanoma

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Inclusion Criteria: Histologic or cytologic documentation of metastatic or Stage IIIc unresectable melanoma, with BRAFV600 mutation.
